author: Tynvale
body:
Since Avicus likes to have unique gamemodes, I have what I think is an amazing idea.
I don't know if a lot of you are aware but sometimes Avicus holds Map Building Competitions.
What I was thinking is that Avicus could hold a competition where people have to make a unique gamemode (like Nebula, etc)
The winner/s could get their gamemode played until the next competition, or be kept on the server if it is well loved in the community.

This may have some pros and cons, so I would love to get opinions/feedback on the idea!
